# heraut check config

Validate .heraut.yml (offline).

Validate .heraut.yml without any network access. Unknown keys, missing fields and invalid values are
reported with their path and a hint.

## Usage

```text
heraut check config [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut check config
heraut check config --config ci/heraut.yml
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | print the result as a JSON envelope |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
